msg: Hello!Its important to make choice before 1,5 seconds runs out!Pick between gnome with pointy hat or flat hat (tall image or short image) one of them will give more points i.e. if tall image - gnome with pointy hat gives you 5+ mushrooms keep picking that one until you start getting just 1 or 2 mushrooms and switch to short image (more of flat hat gnome) to see if you get more mushroom from that gnome - once again keep selecting it until the number gets low.  Sometimes you will get 1 or 0 just keep trying to find which gnome will give you more mushrooms and keep selecting that. Its good to switch up when mushroom number is low to find the high number again. I hope it helps :) Good luck!
